why: Searches confirm the problem is still open in its unconditional form; the Macintyre-Wilkie conditional result (under Schanuel's conjecture) predates the snapshot. A 2025 STACS paper (arXiv:2502.02220) addresses a different, restricted structure (reals with integer powers of a computable number), not Tarski's original problem, and explicitly notes the original question remains open.
